import asyncio, json, time
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from puripuly_heart.core.clock import FakeClock
from puripuly_heart.core.audio.ownership import AudioSegmentTerminalReceipt
from puripuly_heart.core.overlay.presenter import OverlayPresenter
from puripuly_heart.config.overlay_calibration import OverlayCalibration
from puripuly_heart.core.stt.batch_speaker import CausalBatchSession
from puripuly_heart.core.stt.scoped_normalizer import STTScopedTurnNormalizer
from puripuly_heart.core.stt.backend import STTSessionProjection, STTProviderTurnTerminal
from puripuly_heart.providers.stt.local_qwen_sherpa import LocalQwenSherpaSTTBackend
from tests.core.test_causal_batch_speaker import Recognizer, request, payload, seal, span
from tests.core.test_issue264_shared_speaker import frames
from tests.core.test_source_context_contract import ControlledProvider, harness_for, source_fixture, finish, close

async def main():
    started = time.perf_counter()
    clock = FakeClock(_now=10)
    presenter = OverlayPresenter(OverlayCalibration(), clock=clock, visible_window_target_blocks=3)
    translator = ControlledProvider()
    harness, trace = harness_for(translator, overlay_sink=presenter)
    harness.peer_owner.set_clock(clock)
    view = harness.local_asr_runtime.speaker_evidence
    assert view is harness.peer_owner._speaker_identities.evidence
    backend = LocalQwenSherpaSTTBackend(Path('controlled-no-model'), language_hint='English')
    recognizer = Recognizer()
    backend._recognizer = recognizer
    inner = await backend.open_session(projection=STTSessionProjection('scoped', 'provider-1'))
    session = CausalBatchSession(inner, clock=clock.now, evidence_view=view)
    req = replace(request(1), optional_cutoff_at_monotonic_s=99)
    snapshot, _ = source_fixture()
    snapshot = replace(snapshot, identity=req.identity.segment, settings=req.settings, content_ranges=(span(0, 3200),), content_sample_count=3200, display_group_id=req.display_group_id)
    normalizer = STTScopedTurnNormalizer(req.identity)
    events = session.turn_events()
    try:
        await session.begin_turn(req)
        await payload(session, req, 0, 3200, 1)
        view.observe(frames(0, 1600, 0) + frames(1600, 3200, 1))
        await session.observe_speaker_evidence(())
        early = normalizer.apply_update(await asyncio.wait_for(anext(events), 2))
        await harness.peer_owner.handle_provider_turn_update(snapshot, early)
        await finish(harness)
        await harness.output_runtime.wait_for_peer_output_idle()
        assert len(translator.calls) == 1 and presenter.snapshot().blocks[0].speaker_style == 'gold'
        assert session._active is not None and not session._active.sealed
        early_before_natural = {'sources': len(trace.items), 'translations': len(translator.calls), 'text': presenter.snapshot().blocks[0].primary_text, 'selected_pcm_samples': recognizer.calls[0].samples.size}
        await seal(session, req)
        async for event in events:
            if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnTerminal):
                terminal = normalizer.apply_terminal(event)
                await harness.peer_owner.handle_provider_turn_terminal(AudioSegmentTerminalReceipt(req.identity.segment, 'final', snapshot, clock.now()), terminal)
                break
        await finish(harness)
        await harness.output_runtime.wait_for_peer_output_idle()
        req2 = request(2)
        snapshot2 = replace(snapshot, identity=req2.identity.segment, settings=req2.settings, content_ranges=(span(3200, 4800),), content_sample_count=1600, display_group_id=req2.display_group_id)
        await session.begin_turn(req2)
        await payload(session, req2, 3200, 4800, 1)
        await seal(session, req2)
        async for event in events:
            if isinstance(event, STTProviderTurnTerminal):
                terminal2 = STTScopedTurnNormalizer(req2.identity).apply_terminal(event)
                assert terminal2.final_speaker_runs[0].speaker_id is None
                await harness.peer_owner.handle_provider_turn_terminal(AudioSegmentTerminalReceipt(req2.identity.segment, 'final', snapshot2, clock.now()), terminal2)
                break
        await finish(harness)
        await harness.output_runtime.wait_for_peer_output_idle()
        first = presenter.snapshot().blocks[-1]
        assert first.speaker_style == 'gray'
        card = next(entry for entry in presenter._entries.values() if entry.block_id == first.id)
        deadline = presenter._entry_expiration_deadline(card)
        await session.close()
        clock.advance(0.2)
        await harness.peer_owner.observe_speaker_evidence(frames(3200, 4800, 0))
        for _ in range(30):
            if presenter.snapshot().blocks[-1].speaker_style == 'gold':
                break
            await asyncio.sleep(0)
        final = presenter.snapshot().blocks[-1]
        assert final.speaker_style == 'gold' and final.id == first.id and final.appearance_seq == first.appearance_seq
        assert final.primary_text == first.primary_text and final.secondary_text == first.secondary_text
        assert presenter._entry_expiration_deadline(card) == deadline
        assert len(trace.items) == len(translator.calls) == len(harness.peer_runtime.translation_history) == 3
        assert len(view._proofs) == 0 and harness.output_runtime.chatbox.messages == []
        print(json.dumps({'status': 'passed', 'module': 'src/puripuly_heart/core/stt/batch_speaker.py', 'boundaries_controlled': ['Nemotron probabilities', 'native recognizer text', 'translation provider', 'logical transport; no GUI'], 'early_before_natural': early_before_natural, 'sources': len(trace.items), 'translations': len(translator.calls), 'context_records': len(harness.peer_runtime.translation_history), 'styles': [block.speaker_style for block in presenter.snapshot().blocks], 'returning_update_delay_s': 0.2, 'in_place': True, 'ttl_unchanged': True, 'historical_native_final_unknown': terminal2.final_speaker_runs[0].speaker_id is None, 'proofs_after_settlement': len(view._proofs), 'elapsed_s': time.perf_counter() - started}))
    finally:
        await session.close()
        await backend.close()
        await close(harness)
        await presenter.close()

asyncio.run(main())
